about_the_game:
Paddle through the water with your friends!

Are you ready for a fun-filled journey on kayaks or boats? In this game, where you can play with up to 8 friends, you'll need to paddle well—because controlling your boat won’t be so easy!

Explore the islands!

Explore and discover islands with new biomes as you navigate through dangerous paths. Remember, each new biome offers a unique experience, and reaching the next island will always be more challenging!

You must challenge the fun water physics!

Paddling and water physics will challenge you, but that’s not all—be ready to face new obstacles and bosses along the way. You’ll have to overcome them if you want to reach the treasure!

Try different types of boats and kayaks!

The game offers a variety of rides: a single-person kayak, a two-person kayak, a four-person boat, and a two-person jet ski. Remember, larger kayaks and boats are harder to control, so you’ll need your friends! But don’t worry—if you’re playing solo, we’ve designed a single-person kayak and jet ski for you. We want to make sure you can jump into the game no matter what!

Discover new skins!

Remember, the game offers a variety of colors for both your character and your boat. With your own unique combinations, you can become the coolest treasure hunter!

We appreciate your support!

If our game caught your interest, you can support us by adding it to your wishlist! This would make us incredibly happy and keep us motivated. Thank you!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 8/10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3-4170 @ 3.7Ghz OR Intel i5 750 @ 2.67Ghz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia 650TI OR AMD R7 250x
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 650 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 8/10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5 750 @ 2.67Ghz or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GTX 970 OR NVidia GTX 1060 3GB OR AMD R9 290x OR AMD RX 470
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 650 MB available space

short_description: Hop on kayaks and boats for a fun adventure with up to 8 friends! Work together to paddle through cool waters, overcome obstacles and bosses, and reach new islands. If the legend is true, a hidden treasure awaits on the final island. Can you make it without sinking?
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Dutch, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Swedish
